title: KeyBindings.cs
summary: Static access point for the single shared GameControls Input Actions asset, plus save/load/reset of the player's custom key rebinds via PlayerPrefs.

notes.text: A static class — there's exactly one GameControls asset for the whole game, so no instance is needed.
PlayerPrefs key under which rebind overrides are persisted between sessions.
Backing field for the lazily-loaded asset — null until first accessed.
The asset must live in a 'Resources' folder for Resources.Load to find it by name.

notes.match: public static InputActionMap Gameplay => Asset != null ? Asset.FindActionMap("Gameplay") : null;
notes.text: Convenience shortcut — most callers only ever want the 'Gameplay' map, not the whole asset.
Lazy singleton getter: loads the asset from Resources the first time anything asks for it, then returns the cached copy every time after.
Fail loudly if the asset is missing; otherwise load any saved rebind overrides immediately after loading the asset.
Applies previously-saved custom bindings (from Settings ▸ Key Bindings) on top of the defaults baked into the asset.
Serializes the current overrides to JSON and writes them to PlayerPrefs — called after the player rebinds a key.
Wipes all custom overrides back to the asset's defaults, then persists that (empty) override set.
